vocabulary.definition: occurring or done before the usual or proper time; too early
vocabulary.example: The premature baby needed to be kept in an incubator.
The hurricane had a disastrous impact on the coastal town.

vocabulary.definition: favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom
vocabulary.example: The country was ruled by an authoritarian regime that suppressed dissent.

vocabulary.definition: giving the impression that something harmful or evil is happening or will happen
vocabulary.example: The abandoned house had a sinister atmosphere that made people uneasy.

vocabulary.definition: taking place or progressing slowly but steadily
vocabulary.example: Her health deteriorated gradually over the years.

vocabulary.definition: to take over the place, position, or role of; supplant
vocabulary.example: Renewable energy aims to displace traditional fossil fuels in the future energy mix.
